# bc7enc16

This directory vendors the single-file BC7 encoder from
[`richgel999/bc7enc16`](https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc16), pinned at
commit `b37c4bb65af406ab2a1071f2a312bdbe112e4f53`.

Sokoban uses the MIT license option stated in `LICENSE`. Only the encoder is
vendored; the sample program, image codecs, and decoder are not part of the
runtime or content tool.
